kay_wald.title: Theorems on the uniqueness and thermal properties of stationary, nonsingular, quasifree states on spacetimes with a bifurcate Killing horizon
kay_wald.scope: The author abstract concerns linear scalar fields and bifurcate horizons; it states a Kerr nonexistence result within its framework. Full theorem hypotheses not audited; no automatic application to TGL or observed remnants.
